text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Standard-column-space residual fraction | descriptive across ECG records
Each box: across-ECG distribution of per-record means over 6 fixed noises; S mean also averages 5 modes (30 fixed values). Clean is unaveraged.
Box = Q1/median/Q3; whiskers = observed min/max, not CIs. Tick counts = valid record means / null record means. Repeated noises are not patients.
Null denominator remains null and propagates to the record mean; exact zero stays zero. Symlog retains the zero area (linear threshold 1e-14).
Actual noise = float64(noisy float32) - float64(clean float32). q tests only ideal Standard column-space constraints, not complete physiological plausibility.
